name: LocalAttention
reference:
import torch
import math
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, n_heads, window_size):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    B, S, D = x.shape
    head_dim = D // n_heads
    q_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    k_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    v_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    out_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    q = q_proj(x).view(B, S, n_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    k = k_proj(x).view(B, S, n_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    v = v_proj(x).view(B, S, n_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    scores = torch.matmul(q.float(), k.float().transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(head_dim)
    positions = torch.arange(S, device=x.device)
    distance = (positions.unsqueeze(0) - positions.unsqueeze(1)).abs()
    scores = scores.masked_fill((distance >= window_size).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0), float('-inf'))
    weights = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
    output = torch.matmul(weights, v.float()).to(dtype=x.dtype)
    output = output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, S, D)
    return out_proj(output)
description: Local window attention: each position attends only within a fixed window.
